sections.title: Missing addends
facts: $37 + ? = 52$: subtract, $52 - 37 = 15$, or count up from $37$ to $52$.
Check by putting your number back in.

sections.title: Missing numbers in subtraction
facts: $52 - ? = 37$: the missing number is the difference, $15$.
$? - 18 = 25$: the missing number is the whole, $25 + 18 = 43$.

sections.title: Balance
facts: If one number goes up, the other must go down by the same amount.
